How TIME and Statista Determined the World's Best Airports of 2027

The “World’s Best Airports” list is a comprehensive evaluation, conducted by Statista in collaboration with TIME, recognizing airports across the globe that excel in passenger experience and operational performance. The ranking draws on a broad survey of passengers across all continents rating their experience with up to five airports they have used in the past three years, conducted between July 27 and September 4, 2026, using an online access panel.
